zh:
白羽，不，现在该称呼她为上官羽了。
看着她明媚的笑容，和阿笙望向她是温柔的神情，我终于明白了一切。原来阿笙喜欢的人，从来都不是我。先前的桩桩件件，都是他们二人的设局。而他们做这一切，就是为了得到我身上的秘密。
可笑，实在可笑。在利益面前，真心不值一提。不对，阿笙也有真心，只是不在我身上。
“你看她，像不像被一条遗弃的狗？”上官羽笑得娇媚。
“她哪里配和狗相提并论？”阿笙手持小刀，朝我一步步走来，眼里尽是厌弃，“但好在她痴傻，要不然这戏再做下去，我夜夜都要被噩梦惊醒！”
我无处可退，亦无力反抗。被他们二人挑断了手筋脚筋，扔进无忧洞的沟渠中时，我始终睁着眼。我要看清他们二人的模样，我做鬼也不会放过他们！不，我不甘心，我不甘心！我一定要从这地下爬出去，活着爬出去，爬到他们的面前去，向他们讨回我失去的一切！
（老山注：若想继续收看小白花复仇记，需向老山我交付三十长鸣玉。）
en:
Bai Yu, no, now she should be called Shangguan Yu. As I watched her radiant smile, and saw the tenderness in A'Sheng's gaze as he looked at her,
I finally understood everything. The one A'Sheng loved... was not me, never was me. Everything, all of it, had been a carefully laid trap by the two of them. And all of it was done for the secret I carried.

How laughable. How utterly laughable.
True affection meant nothing in the face of profit. No, A'Sheng was capable of true affection. It just wasn't for me.

"Look at her, doesn't she look like a stray dog that's been cast aside?" Shangguan Yu laughed sweetly.

"She's not even worthy of being compared to a dog," A'Sheng advances step by step, a dagger in his hand, disgust in his eyes. "Fortunately, she's stupid enough. Otherwise, having to keep up this farce every night would have given me nightmares!"

I had nowhere to run, no strength left to resist. They severed the tendons in my hands and feet, then tossed me into the gutter of the Unbound Cavern. Even as my body fell, I forced my eyes to remain open. I wanted to see them, to etch their faces into my memory. Even if I became a ghost, I would never forgive them.

No—
I refuse to die like this.
I refuse!
I will claw my way out of this darkness.
I will crawl back into the light.
I will stand before them and take back everything they stole from me!

(Lao Shan's Note: To continue reading the Little White Flower's Revenge, please pay me thirty Echo Jade.)
Help… help… me…!

一楼虽小，可藏今古千秋。
天一楼者，书之渊薮也。楼踞蓬山正中，青瓦白石，重檐歇山，高可接云。蓬山临海，水汽氤氲，天一生水，可克火星，祈典籍永存。楼中架阁千层，缥缃万帙，上自周秦竹帛，下至当朝刻印，兼收并蓄，有“天下第一藏书楼”之美称。
en:
Small though the archive may be, it can hold the anthem of ages from ancient times to the present.
The Tianyi Tower is the great wellspring of books. It stands at the very heart of Penglai, blue tiles and white stone, layered eaves rising high enough to touch the clouds. Penglai faces the sea, and mist and vapour drift ever about it. By the principle that Heaven's first element begets Water and Water subdues Fire, the archive is built as a prayer that the texts within may endure forever. Within the archive, shelves and galleries rise in a thousand tiers, holding ten thousand scrolls and volumes. From the bamboo texts of the Zhou and Qin dynasties to the woodblock prints of the present age, all are gathered here without exception, earning it the celebrated name of the "Number One Archive Under Heaven."

武威市旱滩坡汉墓出土。其木简78枚，木牍14枚。从简牍留痕来看，简有三道编绳，先编而后书，78枚简为一卷册。类有二：一种宽度为1厘米，简的边侧有锲口，简文内容是医治内科、外科、妇科及五官科的医方，还有针灸方面的刺疗医术及禁忌;另一种宽度为0.5厘米，简边侧无锲口，内容是医治各科疾病和疑难症的医方。牍有二道编绳，先书而后编，14枚牍为一卷册。
简书内容丰富，抄录当时验方，保存完整和比较完整的医药方有30多个，涉及内科、外科、妇科、五官科、针灸科等，处方中所列药物近百味。有些药方还详细记载了病名、病状、药物、剂量、制药方法、服药时间、用药方式、针灸穴位及注意事项等，是研究汉代临床医学、针灸学和药物学的重要资料。
en:
Unearthed from the Han Dynasty tomb at Hantanpo in Wuwei City. It includes 78 wooden slips and 14 wooden tablets. Judging from the traces on the slips and tablets, the slips have three binding strings, with binding done before writing; the 78 slips form a single scroll. There are two types of slips: one is 1 cm wide with notches on the sides, containing medical prescriptions for internal medicine, surgery, gynecology, ophthalmology and otolaryngology, as well as acupuncture techniques and taboos; the other is 0.5 cm wide without notches, containing prescriptions for treating various diseases and intractable illnesses. The tablets have two binding strings, with writing done before binding, the 14 tablets form a single scroll. 
The content of the slips is rich, transcribing contemporary proven prescriptions. Over 30 complete or relatively complete medical prescriptions are preserved, covering internal medicine, surgery, gynecology, the five sense organs, acupuncture, etc. The prescriptions list nearly a hundred medicinal ingredients. Some prescriptions also detail disease names, symptoms, drugs, dosages, preparation methods, administration times, modes of application, acupuncture points, and precautions. They are important materials for studying Han Dynasty clinical medicine, acupuncture, and pharmacology.

It was rumored that feeding them a certain small red worm would gradually brighten their color. It wasn't until the Ming and Qing dynasties that breeding techniques became more advanced and standardized.

zh:
演武为3v3公平竞技玩法，在该玩法中少侠的战斗属性将进行调平（角色各属性值一致，装备套装和定音效果可以在槽位调平中自选，奇术为5重15段，心法为6重。）。少侠可以直接匹配或组成3人队进行匹配。演武玩法中，最多可使用20支箭矢，少侠无法复活队友，且玩法中的治疗效果将降低70%。进入战斗一段时间后，玩家伤害将获得提升且治疗效果将进一步下降。

玩家的技能大多都可以以卸势应对，破防奇术不仅不会被卸势，在命中处于防御或在释放卸势技能的目标时，反而有更好的效果，但其可以被任意技能打断。玩法中释放卸势会消耗耐力，而处决命中时会回复耐力。

玩家的各类技能（包括奇术和蓄力技）能够打断轻重击，而反过来则不行。解控技能清风霁月可在受击或控制状态下使用，活用可以有效扭转劣势。

移动端与PC端为独立的匹配池。组队参与玩法时，匹配逻辑遵循以下规则：系统将检测队伍内所有成员的设备类型。一旦检测到存在PC端设备，该队伍会被纳入PC端匹配队列。若玩家在移动端匹配成功后出现跨平台顶号等异常行为，则该玩家后续匹配被归入PC端队列。

在限定时间内，率先击败对方全部玩家的一方获胜，若倒计时结束未分胜负，按以下优先级依次判定：
1.存活玩家数量更多的一方获胜；
2.若存活玩家数量相同，则总伤害量更高一方获胜；
3.若总伤害量相同，则总治疗量更高一方获胜。
en:
In 3v3 Balanced Mode, combat is equalized: all players share standardized attributes, Mystic Skills at Tier 5 Rank 15, and Inner Ways at Tier 6. Gear Set Effects and Arena Attunements can be customized in Slot Leveling. Each player has 20 arrows and cannot revive teammates. Healing effectiveness is reduced by 70% at the start and decreases further as the match progresses, while player damage gradually increases.

Most skills can be countered with Deflect. Defense-breaking Mystic Skills cannot be deflected and deal enhanced damage to targets using Defense or Deflect, but can be interrupted by any skill. Using Deflect costs Endurance, while landing an Execution restores it. Player skills (including Mystic and Charged) can interrupt Light/Heavy Attacks, but not vice versa. Use Break Control Skills like Serene Breeze to escape control effects.

Mobile and PC players queue separately. In team queue, if any member is using a PC, the entire team enters the PC matchmaking pool. Players showing abnormal cross-platform behavior (e.g., account takeover) on mobile will be moved to the PC queue.

Win by eliminating all opponents. If time expires, victory is decided by: 1) Surviving players, 2) Total damage, 3) Total healing.

zh:
是从什么时候变成这样的呢？徐尚浅也想不通。
自己一辈子兢兢业业，读了书，却没能做上大官。只得在城里的书院里谋了个差事。
娘子是父母按照媒婆的推荐为自己选的，是城里人。
丈人家原本看不上自己的出身，好在娘子认定了他踏实肯干，又是白衣读书人。
借住在老丈人家，他娶了娘子。这两年没少受丈人冷嘲热讽。
他踏实肯干，和娘子成婚两年后，买了一处偏僻的小院。几年以后，娘子也给自己生了个儿子。
本以为是一家三口其乐融融，可孩子偏又生得顽劣……

直到自己已至而立之年。他才发现，生活的重担早已磨灭了自己身上那股倔强的少年气息。
曾经，他也是策马围猎的儿郎。他也想过要踏遍五陵路，看尽长安花。
但随着年岁增加，很多事也渐渐被遗忘。他再也不愿提起那些少年时候的豪情壮志。他只想好好活下去。

可光阴的砝码，从不会因为人的意愿而轻上半分。
他只觉得自己肩头的担子越来越重。直到让他再也无法承受。
唯有梦中，他仍骑着高大的骏马，手持长弓，在围场里一路飞驰。
观众席上，娘子抱着乖巧的孩子，正为自己呐喊助威。
徐尚浅知道这是梦。可既然梦能让自己逃离重担，就让它晚点醒来吧。
en:
When did it become like this? Xu Shangqian couldn't figure it out either. 
He had worked diligently all his life and studied the classics, yet never attained a high official post. He could only manage to get a position at an academy in the city. 
His wife was chosen for him by his parents based on a matchmaker's recommendation—a city girl. 
Her family had originally looked down on his humble origins. Fortunately, his wife believed in his steadfastness and hard work, seeing him as a scholar, albeit without rank.
He married his wife while living in his father-in-law's house. For two years, he endured no shortage of cold sneers from the old man. 
He worked steadily and diligently. Two years after marrying, he bought a small, remote house. A few years later, his wife bore him a son. 
He thought it would be a happy life for three. But the boy turned out to be especially unruly... 

By the time he reached thirty, he realized the burdens of life had long since worn away the stubborn, youthful spirit he once carried. 
Once, he too had been a young man galloping on hunts. He too had dreamed of roaming the roads of the capital, seeing all the splendors of Chang'an. 
But over time, many things were gradually forgotten. He no longer wished to speak of the grand ambitions of his youth. He just wanted to live well. 

Yet time's weight never lightens by even half an ounce according to human will. 
He only felt the burden on his shoulders grow heavier and heavier. Until he could no longer bear it. 
Only in dreams did he still ride a tall steed, holding a longbow, galloping across the hunting grounds. 
In the stands, his wife held their well-behaved child, cheering him on. 
Xu Shangqian knew it was a dream. But if a dream could let him escape the burden, let it wake a little later.

zh:
二入长安的夜晚，月光盛极。我在酒家寻到醉醺醺的尉迟青，他已经不记得我，只顾着絮絮念叨着。说来有趣，他喝醉时，连谈吐都变得坦荡了许多。 
“我和阿弟头一回见到长安的月亮……也是这样！月光像蜜酒一样，顺着大街流的满地都是，像条河……我说，完了完了阿弟，长安人喝酒怎么是论街的……阿弟说我醉了，我们坐在蜜酒河旁边……嗝……他吹筚篥给我听，等着我醒酒。我阿弟的筚篥吹得可好了……” 
我忍不住打断他：“世上岂有人能比你的筚篥更好？” 
“哈哈……你也认错人了，对不对？和他们一样……我的筚篥吹的……也就那样！阿弟吹得好些。我嘛……还是擅长喝酒。说起来，那个一次就喝三百杯的长安人呢？叫他出来喝！长安酒家百千楼，我们去喝得家家窖空！” 
“……你是说，你有个比你更擅筚篥的弟弟？” 
我简直要疯了。尉迟青的筚篥我听过，不得不甘拜下风。但若他还有个吹得更好的兄弟，我王麻奴怕是再没脸回幽州。 
“不对、不对，我是……我是阿姐……阿姐醉过去了……我要吹筚篥等她醒……她醉倒在长安的街上，我得在这儿守着她……” 
他茫然地问我：“我吹了好久好久，我的管子碎了……我阿姐呢？” 
“——尉迟青，你醉了。” 
我长出一口气，放下心来。他有个双生姐姐这事儿我知道，据说死的挺早的。原来没有比他更惊才绝艳的弟弟，只有一个醉鬼在胡言乱语。 
醉鬼听到我的话，突然又拍着手开心起来： 
“对，我是醉啦！……阿弟，阿弟，再给我吹一曲，我就醒啦……”
en:
On the night of my second visit to Chang'an, the moonlight was at its peak. I found a drunken Yuchi Qing at the tavern. He no longer remembered me, only muttering incessantly. Interestingly, when drunk, even his speech became much more candid.  
"The first time my younger brother and I saw Chang'an's moon… it was just like this! The moonlight was like honey wine, flowing all over the streets as if it were a river… I said, 'Oh no, oh no, little brother, how come the people of Chang'an drink by the street?'… My brother said I was drunk. We sat by the honey wine river… hic… He played the bili for me, waiting for me to sober up. My brother plays the bili so well…"  
I couldn't help but interrupt him: "How could anyone in the world play the bili better than you?"  
"Haha… you've mistaken me for someone else too, haven't you? Just like the others… My bili playing… is just so-so! My brother plays better. As for me… I'm still better at drinking. Speaking of which, where's that Chang'an man who can drink three hundred cups at once? Call him out to drink! Chang'an has hundreds of taverns with thousands of floors, let's drink every cellar dry!"  
"… You mean you have a younger brother who is more skilled at the bili than you?"  
I was nearly driven mad. I had heard Yuchi Qing play the bili and had to admit defeat. But if he had a brother who played even better, I, Wang Manu, might never dare show my face back in Youzhou again.  
"No, no, I am… I am the elder sister… Elder sister has drunk herself unconscious… I need to play the bili while waiting for her to wake up… She collapsed drunk on a Chang'an street, I have to stay here guarding her…"  
He asked me blankly: "I've played for so long, my pipe broke… Where is my elder sister?"  
"...Yuchi Qing, you're drunk."  
I let out a long sigh of relief. I knew he had a twin sister who reportedly died quite young. So there wasn't a younger brother more brilliant than him, just a drunkard talking nonsense.  
Hearing my words, the drunkard suddenly clapped his hands happily again,  
"Yes, I'm drunk!… Brother, brother, play one more tune for me, and I'll sober up…"

zh:
钟公子是樊楼的常客了，一向是受人喜欢的，近日却总是神神叨叨，念着什么——#Y魁梧的美人。#E非要说是他一眼钟情的知音，要樊楼交出个人来。
世间哪有这般人？樊楼交不出人，他就自己四处找。醉花阴们也不阻拦，不外是笑着问一句：公子，还在寻觅知音呀？
钟公子提着一颗心又憋着一口气，下决心要找到此人不可。他在楼上楼下跑了十几圈，终于摸到当日惊鸿一瞥的小房间。原来房门隐在了屏风之后，难怪遍寻不得！
钟公子大喜，绕过屏风入内，其中却空无一人。
怎么只有一盘棋在这里？棋子都收回去了，也不知道是还没人来下棋，或是刚下完走了。
en:
Master Zhong is a regular at Revelry Hall and a favored guest there. Lately, however, he has taken to muttering to himself, endlessly carrying on about #Ya sturdy beauty#E, insisting it's the soulmate who has captured his heart at first sight, demanding that Revelry Hall produce that person at once.
As if anyone like that could be conjured up. Since the Revelry Hall could offer no such person, he set out to search for them himself. The maidens of Velvet Shade did nothing to stop him; they only smiled and teased, "Still hunting for your soulmate, Master Zhong?"
With his heart in his throat and a stubborn breath caught in his chest, Master Zhong swore he would find this person no matter what. He dashed up and down the tower more than a dozen times before at last finding the little room where he had caught that dazzling glimpse. The door, it turned out, had been hidden behind a folding screen all along. No wonder he had searched in vain!
Overjoyed, he bypassed the screen and hurried inside, only to find the room empty.
Why was there only a chessboard left behind? The pieces had been put away; there was no telling if a player had yet to arrive, or if a game had just ended and they had already departed.

【国风·周南·下】

桃夭

芣苡

采采芣苡，薄言采之。采采芣苡，薄言有之。
采采芣苡，薄言掇之。采采芣苡，薄言捋之。
采采芣苡，薄言袺之。采采芣苡，薄言𮖱之。

汉广

南有乔木，不可休思。汉有游女，不可求思。汉之广矣，不可泳思。江之永矣，不可方思。
翘翘错薪，言刈其楚。之子于归，言秣其马。汉之广矣，不可泳思。江之永矣，不可方思。
翘翘错薪，言刈其蒌。之子于归，言秣其驹。汉之广矣，不可泳思。江之永矣，不可方思。

汝坟

遵彼汝坟，伐其条枚。未见君子，惄如调饥。
遵彼汝坟，伐其条肄。既见君子，不我遐弃。
鲂鱼赪尾，王室如毁。虽则如毁，父母孔迩。

麟之趾

麟之趾，振振公子。于嗟麟兮。
麟之定，振振公姓。于嗟麟兮。
麟之角，振振公族。于嗟麟兮。
en:
[Odes: Zhou South: II]

Tao Yao

Graceful and young the peach tree stands;
How rich its flowers, all gleaming bright!
This bride to her new home repairs;
Chamber and house she'll order right.
Graceful and young the peach tree stands;
Large crops of fruit it soon will show.
This bride to her new home repairs;
Chamber and house her sway shall know.
Graceful and young the peach tree stands,
Its foliage clustering green and full.
This bride to her new home repairs;
Her household will attest her rule.

Tu Ju

Careful he sets his rabbit-nets all round;
Chang-chang his blows upon the pegs resound.
Stalwart the man and bold his bearing all
Shows he might be his prince's shield and wall.
Careful he is his rabbit-nets to place,
Where many paths of rabbits' feet bear trace.
Stalwart the man and bold 'tis plain to see
He to his prince companion good would be.
Careful he is his rabbit-nets to spread,
Where in the forest's depth the trees give shade.
Stalwart the man and bold fit his the part
Guide to his prince to be, and faithful heart.

Fu Yi

We gather and gather the plantains;
Come gather them anyhow.
Yes, gather and gather the plantains,
And here we have got them now.
We gather and gather the plantains;
Now off the ears we must tear.
Yes, gather and gather the plantains,
And now the seeds are laid bare.
We gather and gather the plantains,
The seeds in our skirts are placed.
Yes, gather and gather the plantains.
Ho! safe in the girdled waist!

Han Guang

High and compressed, the southern trees
No shelter from the sun afford.
The girls free ramble by the Han,
But will not hear enticing word.
Like the broad Han are they,
Through which one cannot dive;
And like the Jiang's long stream,
Wherewith no raft can strive.
Many the faggots bound and piled;
The thorns I'd hew still more to make.
As brides, those girls their new homes seek;
Their colts to feed I'd undertake.
Like the broad Han are they,
Through which one cannot dive;
And like the Jiang's long stream,
Wherewith no raft can strive.
Many the faggots bound and piled;
The southernwood I'd cut for more.
As brides, those girls their new homes seek;
Food for their colts I'd bring large store.
Like the broad Han are they,
Through which one cannot dive;
And like the Jiang's long stream,
Wherewith no raft can strive.

Ru Fen

Along the raised banks of the Ru,
To hew slim stem and branch I wrought,
My lord away, my husband true,
Like hunger-pang my troubled thought!
Along the raised banks of the Ru,
Branch and fresh shoot confessed my art.
I've seen my lord, my husband true,
And still he folds me in his heart.
As the toiled bream makes red its tail,
Toil you, Sir, for the royal House,
Amidst its blazing fires, nor quail:
Your parents see you pay your vows.

Lin Zhi Zhi

As the feet of the lin, which avoid each living thing,
So our prince's noble sons no harm to people will bring.
They are the lin!
As the front of the lin, never forward thrust in wrath,
So our prince's noble grandsons of love tread the path.
They are the lin!
As the horn of the lin, flesh-tipped, no wound to give,
So our prince's noble kindred kindly with all live.
They are the lin!
Kitty: Mohist

Q: What is the name of a Mohist? A: To benefit all under Heaven; thus, a Mohist is nameless.

Q: What is the wish of a Mohist? A: That the waters be shared equally across the world, bringing prosperity to all.

zh:
君不见是个小偷，但是有文化的小偷。
出生时，君不见的父母因常听一些喝醉的书生吟唱什么“君不见黄河之水天上来”觉得很有文化，所以给孩子取名叫君不见。君不见后来还专门了解过这首诗，他很喜欢里面的一个词“天生我财”——既然财富都是天生给我的，那拿一点也就不叫偷了。
现在君不见在未央城瞄上了一个富家少爷温无痕。他认为这种人虽然看起来很精明，但是最好偷，而且他们身上的钱换成馒头至少可以养活数百个人。
君不见再见温无痕时已是七日后。那时温无痕饿得奄奄一息。他不明白为什么这个富家少爷已经快饿死了，还是不愿意回家。可惜他从温无痕身上偷走的钱早已散了出去，身上就只剩下一块发馊的馒头。
后来君不见才知道，温无痕讨厌他的那个家。那个家虽然姓温，但是却冰冷异常。于是君不见告诉温无痕，以后你过生日的时候我请你吃新鲜的白面馒头。这是温无痕第一次感受到温暖。
今日是温无痕的生辰，君不见早早地便出门了。而温无痕知道君不见喜欢变戏法，于是从家中偷来一本五鬼搬运术本打算给他一个惊喜，却在君不见的狗窝中看到了自己被偷走的钱袋子。
原来造成这一切的罪魁祸首就是他，君不见！温无痕发誓，一定要杀了君不见。因为他把他当成自己的朋友。可是君不见却再也没回来……
温无痕回到了温家，听说温家六子死了四个，温无痕成了温家的掌舵人。江湖上也出现了一个自称天生我财的盗圣。每年温无痕的生辰礼，盗圣都会出现，并在众目睽睽之下，偷走温无痕最喜欢的礼物，却又送回来。
en:
Jun Bujian was a thief, but a cultured thief. 
When he was born, his parents often overheard drunken scholars reciting lines like "Have you not seen the Yellow River's waters descending from the heavens?" Thinking it sounded refined, they named him Jun Bujian ("Have You Not Seen"). Later, he looked up the poem himself and fell in love with one particular phrase: "Heaven bequeaths me talents." If wealth is heaven-sent, he reasoned, then taking a little isn't really stealing, is it? 
Now, in Weiyang City, Jun Bujian has his eyes on a young nobleman: Wen Wuhen. The kind who seems shrewd but is actually the easiest to rob, and whose coin, in terms of steamed buns, could feed hundreds. 
When they meet again seven days later, Wen Wuhen is half-dead from hunger. Jun Bujian can't fathom why the boy refuses to return home, even when starving. Pity that the money he'd lifted from him is long gone, spent on others. All he has left is a single moldy bun. 
Eventually, he learns the truth: Wen Wuhen hates his family. The "Wen" ("Warm") Manor is anything but. So Jun Bujian makes a promise: "Next birthday, I'll treat you to fresh white-flour buns." It's the first warmth Wen Wuhen has ever known. 
Today is Wen Wuhen's birthday, and Jun Bujian leaves early. Meanwhile, Wen Wuhen, knowing his friend loves magic tricks, steals a manual on Five Ghosts Command from his family vault, planning to surprise him. But in Jun Bujian's dingy hideout, he finds something else: his own stolen identity plaque. 
So he was the culprit all along, Jun Bujian! Betrayed, Wen Wuhen vows to kill him. Because he'd trusted him. Yet Jun Bujian never returns. 
Wen Wuhen went back to the Wen family. After four of its six heirs perished under mysterious circumstances, he became its head. Meanwhile, Jianghu buzzed about a new Master Thief who calls himself "Heaven's Bequeathed Talent." Every year, on Wen Wuhen's birthday, the thief appears, steals his favorite gift in plain sight, and then gives it back.

白雪歌送武判官归京

忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开。
散入珠帘湿罗幕，狐裘不暖锦衾薄。
将军角弓不得控，都护铁衣冷难着。
瀚海阑干百丈冰，愁云惨淡万里凝。
中军置酒饮归客，胡琴琵琶与羌笛。
纷纷暮雪下辕门，风掣红旗冻不翻。

山回路转不见君，雪上空留马行处。

【暑】

夏夜叹
杜甫
永日不可暮，炎蒸毒我肠。
安得万里风，飘飖吹我裳。
昊天出华月，茂林延疏光。
仲夏苦夜短，开轩纳微凉。
虚明见纤毫，羽虫亦飞扬。
物情无巨细，自适固其常。
念彼荷戈士，穷年守边疆。
何由一洗濯，执热互相望。
竟夕击刁斗，喧声连万方。
青紫虽被体，不如早还乡。
北城悲笳发，鹳鹤号且翔。
况复烦促倦，激烈思时康。

【晴】

新晴野望
王维
新晴原野旷，极目无氛垢。
郭门临渡头，村树连溪口。
白水明田外，碧峰出山后。
农月无闲人，倾家事南亩。

竹枝词二首·其一
刘禹锡
杨柳青青江水平，闻郎江上唱歌声。
东边日出西边雨，道是无晴却有晴。

晚晴

深居俯夹城，春去夏犹清。
天意怜幽草，人间重晚晴。

【旱】

苦热行
王维
赤日满天地，火云成山岳。
草木尽焦卷，川泽皆竭涸。
轻纨觉衣重，密树苦阴薄。
莞簟不可近，絺绤再三濯。
思出宇宙外，旷然在寥廓。
长风万里来，江海荡烦浊。
却顾身为患，始知心未觉。
忽入甘露门，宛然清凉乐。

夏旱
白居易
太阴不离毕，太岁仍在午。
旱日与炎风，枯焦我田亩。
金石欲销铄，况兹禾与黍。
嗷嗷万族中，唯农最辛苦。
悯然望岁者，出门何所睹。
但见棘与茨，罗生遍场圃。
恶苗承沴气，欣然得其所。
感此因问天，可能长不雨。
en:
【Climate】

【Cold】

Song of White Snow in Farewell to Secretary Wu Going Back to the Capital
Cen Shen
Snapping the pallid grass, the northern wind whirls low;
In the eighth moon the Tartar sky is filled with snow.
As if the vernal breeze had come back overnight,
Adorning thousands of pear trees with blossoms white.
Flakes enter pearled blinds and wet the silken screen;
No furs of fox can warm us nor brocade quilts, I ween.
The general cannot draw his rigid bow with ease;
E’en the commissioner in coat of mail would freeze.
A thousand feet o’er cracked wilderness ice piles,
And gloomy clouds hang sad and drear for miles and miles.
We drink in headquarters to our guest homeward bound;
With Tartar lutes, pipas and pipes the camps resound.
Snow in large flakes at dusk falls heavy on camp gate;
The frozen red flag in the wind won’t undulate.
At eastern gate of Wheel Tower we bid goodbye
On the snow-covered road to Heaven’s Mountain high.
I watch his horse go past a bend and, lost to sight,
His track will soon be buried up by snow in flight.

【Heat】

Lament on a Summer Day
Du Fu
How can I bear the long, long summer day!
The scorching sun burns my bowels away.
Where can I find a wind from far-off land
To blow my gown and make me feel less grand?
The sky brings out the moon fair as a flower,
The forest sheds sparse light on her green bower.
In midsummer the night is short, alas!
I open windows to let in cool grass.
In the clear light I see the smallest things,
And insects flying with their flapping wings.
All things, great or small, have their own way,
And each is contented, so they say.
I think of soldiers guarding the frontiers,
Who’ve passed the whole year there, full of tears.
How can they wash themselves in water clean?
They look at each other in heat, I ween.
They beat their clappers all the night long,
Their noise is heard in places far and strong.
Though clad in blue and purple, they’d prefer
To go back home, however coarser their fur.
Sad flutes are played in northern city wall,
Storks and cranes cry and fly over all.
I’m tired of the noise and haste, and long
For a peaceful world, healthy and strong.

【Clear】

View of the Fields after a Fresh Rain
Wang Wei
After a fresh rain at the end of day,
The open country’s fine without a fleck.
The outer gate overlooks the ferry way,
The village trees are joined to the creek’s neck.
White water gleams bright in the fields outside,
Green hill-tops emerge from the mountainside.
In busy months no farmer is at leisure,
All households are busy in southern fields with pleasure.

Two Songs of Bamboo Branch (I)
Liu Yuxi
Between the willows green the river flows along;
My gallant in a boat is heard to sing a song.
The west is veiled in rain, the east enjoys sunshine;
My gallant is as deep in love as the day is fine.

Fine Evening
Li Shangyin
Living deep, I look down on the town in the vale;
Spring’s gone, but summer still is fresh and hale.
Heaven favours the grass growing in the dark;
On earth we love fine evening after rain and spark.
I mount the tower and see a longer view;
Through windows small the sunbeams slant into.
The nest of southern birds is dried by evening fine;
They fly back lighter than the slanting sunshine.

【Drought】

Song of Suffering from Heat
Wang Wei
The sun reddens the sky and the earth below;
The fiery clouds look like mountains in a row.
All plants are scorched and withered, I’m afraid;
All rivers and lakes are dried up, I’m dismayed.
Light silk gown feels heavy on my body bare;
Dense trees give little shade, I can hardly bear.
I cannot sleep on mat or pillow spread;
I wash my linen gown again and again in dread.
I wish to go beyond the universe,
And feel carefree in the sky so vast and diverse.
The wind blows from afar over rivers and seas,
And sweeps away the heat and dirt with ease.
Looking back, I find my body suffers from heat;
I did not know my mind was in defeat.
Suddenly I come to the door of sweet dew,
And feel as if I were in a cool world new.

Summer Drought
Bai Juyi
The moon does not leave the star Bi in the sky;
The year is still in the hour of the horse on high.
The scorching sun and hot wind burn my field,
And all my crops are withered, none can yield.
Even metal and stone would melt in heat,
Not to say millet and wheat.
Of all people under the sun,
None suffer more than farmers, none.
Those who look forward to a harvest year
See nothing pleasant far and near.
They see but thorns and brambles here and there,
Which grow all over the fields, I swear.
The noxious seedlings thrive in the foul air,
And grow luxuriantly without a care.
Moved by this, I ask Heaven why
It won’t send down rain from the sky.

梅花遍地的山谷里，睡道人停留的时间比其他地方多得多……嗯，不仅无人吵醒，清香更是助眠。小驴子新得仙鹤为友，欣喜万分，学着仙鹤的模样，昂首挺胸，更添风雅。然而，据驴梦中所言，它的新仪态绝非东施效颦，而是一种发自内心的骄傲——毕竟这是山上，驴子的行动可比马利索许多！
en:
Plum shadows lie aslant, hidden fragrance fills the air. Cranes visit the tranquil vale, and Solitary Hill is solitary no more.
In a valley carpeted with plum blossoms, the Sleeping Daoist lingers far longer than anywhere else... Mm, not only is there no one to wake him, the delicate fragrance even helps him sleep. His little donkey, delighted to have made friends with a crane, imitates its proud stance with head high and chest out, looking more elegant by the moment. Yet according to what the donkey later said in its dreams, this new bearing is no clumsy imitation but pride from the heart. After all, up in the mountains, a donkey moves far more nimbly than a horse!

Dear Wanderer,

How are you? I write with glad tidings. Thanks to your help, I've set up my stall at the Wheatwind Bazaar in Kaifeng Suburbs-South. When I left home, I never dreamed such a day…
Grandfather always said gratitude must be more than words. So I've sent my savings back to Fuping, my hometown, to lease five mu of persimmon groves in your name. Grandfather and the villagers tend them. He insisted on having the old painter paint them for you. I can already imagine the fiery red blaze!
But the weather's been cruel this year, drought and flood by turns. The harvest would likely suffer… May the land prove worthy.

zh:
暗处的水，能流向更远的地方。
有时候那水，是摇着归家之梦的清波。烽火连天，家书万金，流民营地里犹有人执笔飞书，将一颗颗滚烫的心封入信笺，借着水波，送至望眼欲穿的人手里。
有时候那水，是刀光剑影中的墨迹。祁家庄上，有义士孤身入敌营，虽困于牢笼之中，却几经辗转，将那重要的敌情，送至江湖同道人手里。
还有一种水，它们用秘密，用信札，用承诺，连起山河间的脉络。它们隐于无形，却暗牵缓急，掀起惊涛，将一个千万人甘愿为之奔赴的秘密，送往远方人们的手中。
它们循着燕北的星火，汇于此处。而后，方有江湖万顷，以抵火海。
en:
Hidden waters can travel farther than any road.
Sometimes that water carries dreams of home. As war rages on, a letter from home is worth its weight in gold, and in the refugee camps, some still take up the pen, sealing their burning hearts into every page and entrusting them to the currents, that they might reach the ones who wait, longing for their return.
Sometimes that water takes the shape of ink amid the flash of blades. At Qi Manor, a lone hero slipped into the enemy camp; though thrown in a cage, through many turns he passed word of vital intelligence into the hands of his allies in the jianghu.
And there is yet another kind of water, one that binds the veins of the land with secrets, with letters, with promises. Unseen, it quietly commands the ebb and rush of things, raising great waves, carrying a secret worth ten thousand lives into hands far away.
They follow the sparks of the north, and gather here. And so the boundless jianghu takes shape, vast enough to meet a sea of fire.
Qinchuan - The Huayu Road

zh: 寿昌坊，取寿比南山，昌似东海之意。旧时泛指宫城西、北两侧地界，间有军器监、油醋库、引见司、麟台等官署重地，亦有沈宅、范宅、赵宅等高官宅邸错落分布。往来其间者，簪星曳月，非富即贵，多为朝中官员、行脚商贾、纨绔子弟等。至宋时，兵部尚书析地之形势，置民之新居，重划旧地，为寿昌坊、咸宁坊、天波坊三坊。遂今人单称金水门街以南之地，为寿昌坊。
en: Shouchang Fang, named to embody "longevity as enduring as Southern Mountains, prosperity as vast as Eastern Sea," historically referred to areas west and north of the imperial palace. It housed key government offices like the Armaments Bureau, Oil and Vinegar Depot, Imperial Audiences Office, and Lin Tai (Imperial Library), alongside mansions of high officials such as the Shen, Fan, and Zhao families. Those frequenting here—adorned with star-like hairpins and moon-like sashes—were exclusively the wealthy or noble, including court officials, traveling merchants, and pampered heirs. In the Song Dynasty, the Minister of War redivided the area based on terrain, establishing Prosperity Haven, Tranquil Haven, and Tidal Haven. Thus, the region south of Goldwater Street is now solely called Prosperity Haven.

zh: 不知在我出仕前，有没有资格刻一块自己的碑文？
en: I wonder whether I'll accomplish enough to earn my own inscription before I enter office.

zh: 桃花的枝条，上面还带有几朵粉嫩的花苞，正是春光明媚的时候。
en: A peach branch. Several delicate pink buds still cling to it, perfectly representing the bright beauty of spring.
Trapped behind enemy lines.
